verdict.rationale: cubic applies automation across many items without per-item action. It automatically reviews every new PR (cubic-docs-1, cubic-docs-47), and auto-fix can fix the issues from every review of a PR (cubic-docs-66). Codebase scans sweep an entire repository (cubic-docs-12), and an org-level `cubic-config` repo applies one `cubic.yaml` across repositories (cubic-docs-67). These are automatic, policy-wide behaviours rather than user-initiated bulk operations on selected items, and no OpenAPI spec was found (cubic-probe-3). Missing for 10: explicit bulk actions over chosen sets (e.g. triage or resolve many findings or PRs at once), batch operations via MCP or CLI, a documented bulk or batch API, and hands-on corroboration.
